## Classification

Tick one and add the matching label. The reviewer may raise the classification but never lower it.

- [ ] `trivial`: docs/tooling/config, no runtime behaviour change.
- [ ] `uncertain`: runtime behaviour, covered by tests, but involved judgment calls.
- [ ] `needs-human-review`: public API, gesture/physics feel, a11y, new dependencies, architecture.

Also add one release-plan label: `breaking`, `enhancement`, `bug`, `documentation` or `internal`.

The reviewer adds the `reviewed` label on approval. Any later push makes it stale until the reviewer re-reviews.
